svg.title: What happens when Greenbone scans WKS01
svg.desc: Greenbone connects to WKS01 over SMB as svc-greenbone. WKS01 asks DC01 to verify the account and receives its group memberships. WKS01 finds the role's SID in its local Administrators group and grants an admin session, so Greenbone can read the registry, installed software and patch level.
